description: This Java class provides XML schema support for Android-related XML files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It manages schema retrieval, namespace handling, and resource file validation for Android XML files.

classes.name: AndroidXmlSchemaProvider
classes.description: Provides XML schema support for Android resource files and manifests within the IDE, including schema retrieval, namespace management, and resource validation.

methods.name: getSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the XML schema (XSD) for a given URL within a specific module and base file context.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the given XML file is an Android resource or manifest file and if the schema provider is applicable.

methods.name: isXmlResourceFile
methods.description: Determines if a given XML file is an Android resource file based on its directory and resource type.

methods.name: getAvailableNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the set of XML namespaces available for a given Android XML file.

methods.name: getDefaultPrefix
methods.description: Provides the default namespace prefix for a given namespace URI in the context of an XML file.

methods.name: getLocalXmlNamespace
methods.description: Determines the local XML namespace URI based on the Android project's manifest package or project type.
